help.enabled: Enable automatic task reminders; manual checks stay available.
help.language: Change this panel only; Pi and notification text stay unchanged.
help.reload: Reload settings after edits made outside this panel.
help.nativeNotification: Show silent desktop notifications; sound is separate.
help.backend: Automatic uses the notification service for this system.
help.notifyWhenFocused: Allow completion notifications while this terminal has focus.
help.notifyWhenUnfocused: Allow completion notifications while this terminal is unfocused.
help.notificationBody: Leave empty for defaults; {session} and {duration} work here.
help.soundEnabled: Play completion sounds independently of desktop notifications.
help.soundPreset: Choose a named sound; open the list to preview with P.
help.soundWhenFocused: Play completion sounds while this terminal has focus.
help.soundWhenUnfocused: Play completion sounds while this terminal is unfocused.
help.notifyOnError: Alert if the main run ends in failure; background tasks use Add-ons.

help.minWorkMs: Skip short main/background runs; waiting for answers is exempt.
help.minAwayMs: Notify after enough continuous time away; sound is not delayed.
help.unknownFocusPolicy: Choose how to alert when this terminal's focus is unknown.
help.notifyOnAsk: Alert for connected questions waiting while away; no added sound.
help.subagentNotifications: Alert on separate background tasks from the connected add-on.
help.subagentOnSuccess: When background alerts are enabled, include successful tasks.
help.subagentOnFailure: When background alerts are enabled, include failed tasks.
help.previewSound: Play the current sound once; do not change settings.
